questions.text: A fixed paper preserves the original question order.
questions.explanation: All questions appear in their imported order.

questions.text: Leaving a timed paper pauses its countdown.
questions.explanation: The deadline is saved and continues across navigation.

questions.text: Explain why a model answer should allow equivalent wording.
answer: Equivalent wording can express the same correct ideas. A rubric should assess the concepts and reasoning rather than demand exact text.
questions.explanation: Several valid phrasings may communicate the same understanding.
questions.rubric: 1 mark for recognizing equivalent wording; 1 for assessing concepts; 1 for assessing reasoning. Accept other valid explanations.

questions.explanation: Add arrival to duration for each completion time.
questions.rubric: 1 mark for each correct cell (4 total), plus 1 for a consistent completed table. Equivalent numeric formats are acceptable.
